claims.claim_text: Electric Boat is the prime contractor and lead shipyard on Columbia-class ballistic-missile submarines, a 12-boat program; the Navy considers Columbia its top acquisition priority; the value of the Navy's program of record is in excess of $115 billion, with first boat delivery scheduled for 2027.
claims.subject: Electric Boat (General Dynamics)
claims.predicate: is prime contractor on / primary revenue driver from
claims.object_value: Columbia-class SSBN, 12 boats, >$115B program of record
claims.source_quote: Electric Boat is the prime contractor and lead shipyard on all Navy nuclear-powered submarine programs... The Columbia-class ballistic-missile submarine is a 12-boat program that the Navy considers its top acquisition priority... the value of the Navy's program of record is in excess of $115 billion.

claims.claim_text: Navy procures Virginia-class submarines in multi-boat blocks at a two-per-year rate; GD has 16 Virginia-class submarines in backlog scheduled for delivery through 2032, currently working Blocks IV and V; ten Block V boats will include the Virginia Payload Module.
claims.subject: Electric Boat (General Dynamics)
claims.predicate: has multi-year revenue pipeline tied to
claims.object_value: Virginia-class SSN Block IV/V, 16-boat backlog through 2032
claims.source_quote: The Navy procures Virginia-class submarines in multi-boat blocks at a two-per-year rate. Along with an industry partner, we are currently working on Blocks IV and V in the program, with 16 Virginia-class submarines in our backlog scheduled for delivery through 2032. Ten of the boats in Block V will include the Virginia Payload Module.

claims.claim_text: Land Systems is the sole-source producer of the Abrams main battle tank and the Stryker wheeled combat vehicle; both are central to U.S. Army warfighting; in 2023 the Army announced it will develop the new M1E3 Abrams main battle tank as an engineering change for future threats.
claims.subject: GD Land Systems
claims.predicate: is sole-source producer of / has forward program for
claims.object_value: Abrams (M1A2 SEPv3 and M1E3 development), Stryker
claims.source_quote: Land Systems is the sole-source producer of two foundational products central to the U.S. Army's warfighting capabilities — the Abrams main battle tank and Stryker wheeled combat vehicle... In 2023, the Army announced that it will develop the new M1E3 Abrams main battle tank.

claims.claim_text: Ordnance and Tactical Systems (OTS) maintains market-leading position in Hydra-70 rockets, bomb bodies, large-caliber tank ammunition, medium-caliber ammunition, military propellants, mortar and 155mm artillery suite; in 2023 OTS received awards to expand 155mm metal parts production capacity from 18,000 to 86,000 rounds per month by 2025.
claims.subject: GD Ordnance and Tactical Systems
claims.predicate: has expanding capacity / forward revenue from
claims.object_value: 155mm artillery + Hydra-70 + medium caliber munitions; capacity 18k→86k rounds/mo by 2025
claims.source_quote: Globally, we maintain a market-leading position in the supply of Hydra-70 rockets, bomb bodies, large-caliber tank ammunition, medium-caliber ammunition, military propellants, mortar and a 155mm artillery suite of ammunition. In 2023, OTS received awards to expand its existing metal parts production capacity from 18,000 to 86,000 rounds per month by 2025.

claims.claim_text: Combat Systems is producing and upgrading Piranha 5 vehicles for non-U.S. customers including Denmark, Romania and Spain; offers the ASCOD tracked combat vehicle and Eagle wheeled vehicle.
claims.subject: GD European Land Systems
claims.source_quote: ELS is producing and upgrading Piranha vehicles, a premier 8x8 armored combat vehicle, around the world. We are currently providing Piranha 5 vehicles for several countries, including Denmark, Romania and Spain.

claims.claim_text: Technologies segment (GDIT + Mission Systems) employs ~40,000 personnel including cleared technologists; serves DoD, intelligence community, and federal civilian customers; 2023 segment revenue was $12,922M with $12,257M from U.S. government.
claims.subject: GD Technologies (GDIT + Mission Systems)
claims.object_value: U.S. government (DoD/IC/federal civilian); $12.26B of $12.92B 2023 segment revenue (94.9%) from USG
claims.source_quote: Technologies $12,922... Revenue from U.S. Government $12,257... The segment's highly skilled workforce is one of its key differentiators and comprises approximately 40,000 employees, including technologists, engineers, mission experts and cleared personnel.

claims.claim_text: Approximately 70% of GD's 2023 consolidated revenue ($30,327M of $42,272M) was from the U.S. government; long-term contracts span several years and are conditioned on continuing congressional appropriations.
claims.subject: General Dynamics consolidated
claims.source_quote: In 2023, approximately 70% of our consolidated revenue was from the U.S. government... Future revenue under existing multi-year contracts is conditioned on the continuing availability of congressional appropriations.

claims.claim_text: Gulfstream G700 expected to enter service following FAA certification in early 2024; G800 and G400 to follow; G500/G600 cumulative deliveries totaled over 250 at year-end 2023.
claims.subject: Gulfstream (GD Aerospace)
claims.object_value: G700 entry into service in early 2024
claims.source_quote: We expect the G700 to enter service following certification from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) in early 2024.

claims.claim_text: General Dynamics owns a large portfolio of proprietary intellectual property and licenses some IP to and from others; the U.S. government holds licenses to many GD patents developed in performance of U.S. government contracts.
claims.subject: General Dynamics Corporation
claims.source_quote: We develop technology, manufacturing processes and systems-integration practices. In addition to owning a large portfolio of proprietary intellectual property, we license some intellectual property rights to and from others.
